title: WPChat plugin for WordPress before 1.4.6 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
description: The WPChat plugin for WordPress versions prior to 1.4.6 has a broken access control vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to reuse a publicly exposed nonce to invoke an admin-level action without proper capability checks. Specifically, attackers can call the claim-offer action via a POST request to the plugin's REST API endpoint, enabling them to register an attacker-controlled email address with the site's domain. This compromises the WPChat account and newsletter identity linked to the WordPress installation.
